title: Inside the largest fusion reactor: a video investigation
description: Watch The B1M's 2022 video from inside ITER with vocabulary, predictions and note frames, then check its claims against verified facts of November 2026 and evaluate it as a source.

sources.title: The B1M: We Went Inside the Largest Nuclear Fusion Reactor (video page with the narration as an article; 13 April 2022; paid promotion for Thinkproject)
sources.note: Claims checked: 35 nations, 23,000 tonnes, about one million components, 104 km of adapted roads, ten times hotter than the Sun's core, forces about twice a space-shuttle launch, $22 billion, first power-on 2025, net energy, grid connection decades away.
